🌍 World Vitiligo Day | June 25

What if your skin suddenly began to change, and the world started seeing you differently—would you feel seen, or misunderstood?

Today, on World Vitiligo Day, let’s raise awareness, break myths, and celebrate confidence beyond skin color.

Vitiligo is not contagious and can affect anyone. Early diagnosis and appropriate treatment can help manage the condition, while compassion and understanding help build confidence.

If you notice white patches on your skin or have concerns about vitiligo, consult a qualified dermatologist for timely evaluation.

Every skin tells a story. Every shade deserves respect. 🤍

📍 SATVACH Clinic – Skin, Hair & Aesthetic Care

Buying sunscreen? Don't just check the SPF number.

As a dermatologist, here's what I actually look for on the label:

✅ PA+++ minimum — UVA protection for pigmentation & ageing
✅ Critical wavelength ≥ 370nm — full spectrum UVA coverage
✅ In vivo tested SPF — tested on real skin, more reliable
✅ Safe UV filters — avoid filters with systemic absorption risk

Save this before your next pharmacy visit.

Celebrate Holi Beautifully — Protect Your Skin & Hair This Festive Season
This Holi, let your skin glow as bright as the colours you celebrate with. 🎨
At Satvach Clinic – Advanced Skin & Hair Care, we believe festivities should never come at the cost of your skin and hair health. Colours — both natural and synthetic — can strip your skin’s moisture barrier and leave your hair dry, brittle, and damaged.
Here’s how to protect yourself like a pro:
✨ Before Holi — Apply a generous layer of SPF 50+ sunscreen and coat your hair with a nourishing oil or serum. This creates a protective barrier against colour penetration.
✨ During Holi — Stay hydrated. Healthy skin always starts from within.
✨ After Holi — Cleanse gently with a sulphate-free wash. Never scrub aggressively — it damages your skin barrier. Follow up with deep hydration and a good moisturiser.
⚠️ Noticing rashes, pigmentation, irritation or excessive hair fall post-Holi? Don’t ignore it — your skin deserves expert attention.

featured_reviews.name: Rupesh Londhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was undergoing treatment here since 2021, I even got results in the first year. I even commented to thank to the dermatologist for that. But every month when I went there, they would prescribe new medicines in just 5 minutes without doing any physical checkup.
The dermatologist have expressions on his face that the patient should be leave within 5 minutes. Medicines were also very expensive and if you bought them from here, they would give you on the MRP prices, if you bought the same medicines from outside, you would get a 15% discount...
Back in 2025, I went for PRP before the Diwali holidays, they first took my blood sample and made me wait for a long time it is ok I can understand that is a process, but then suddenly they took me to do PRP without giving anesthesia. I was in so much pain that my head hurt for 2 days...
When I went to the dermatologist again on the next month, the medicine he had prescribed made my hair fall out within 10 days instead of growing... When I told him for this, it was clear on his face that he had prescribed the wrong medicine in a hurry...
Then suddenly he started saying that okay let's do another PRP. I said the last time you did PRP my head was hurting so much they said no one has said anything like this till now... Looking at all this I understand that this dermatologist calls the patient every month and gives him medicine to come back... from this I have stopped going to him now...

Thank u for sharing ur perspective but we take patient feedback seriously and its unfair to all those genuine reviews n happy patients which we have served throughout the years.

We can understand that  its disappointing when results dont meet expectations but if there r misunderstanding n if u would like review ur treatment journey  in details , we would be very happy to do so. You can reach out to us anytime we r always here to help u.

In the aesthetic and hair-restoration treatment, there are many types of PRP, although scientifically they often fall into a few basic categories. 

1. Standard PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma)
Prepared by centrifuging blood to concentrate platelets.
Most common for hair loss & skin rejuvenation.

2. Double-Spin PRP
High-concentration PRP."
Commonly used in hair restoration.
ProvideS higher growth factor levels than single-spin PRP.

3. Leukocyte-Rich PRP (L-PRP)
Used in orthopedics.

4. Leukocyte-Poor PRP (LP-PRP)
Preferred for facial rejuvenation & hair treatments.

5. Activated PRP
Activator is added before injection.
Causes immediate release of growth factors.
It is also called as growth-factor PRP.

6. Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC)
Popular in India.
Directly releases growth factors.
Contains concentrated growth factors.
It is superior to PRP.

7. PRFM (Platelet-Rich Fibrin Matrix)
Brands include Selphyl & TruPRP.
Creates a fibrin scaffold that slowly releases growth factors.
It is "next-generation PRP."

8. i-PRF
Popular in regenerative aesthetics & dentistry.
Provides prolonged growth factor release.

9. A-PRF (Advanced Platelet-Rich Fibrin)

10. C-PRF (Concentrated PRF)
Higher concentration of platelets and fibrin.

11. Stem Cell PRP
PRP mixed with:
    Exosomes
    SVF 
    Nanofat
    Bone marrow concentrate

12. Exosome-Enhanced PRP
PRP combined with exosomes.
It is an advanced regenerative therapy.

13. Vampire PRP / Vampire Facial®
standard PRP with microneedling.

Dutexome Solution is a non injectable hair mesotherapy treatment which is designed to treat Androgenetic Alopecia & hair thinning. It is a combination of dutasteride, exosomes & copper peptides. It stimulates dormant follicles, reduces DHT-induced hair loss & increases hair density. This is the latest advancement in hair loss therapy.

Key Components
Dutasteride (0.05%): It inhibits 5-alpha reductase which directly reduces dihydrotestosterone (DHT), the primary cause of genetic hair loss.

Exosomes: It utilizes nanotechnology to activate dormant follicles & accelerate their regeneration.

Copper Peptides: It enhances scalp microcirculation, strengthens the hair roots & improves the hair thickness.

Vitamin B-Complex: It promotes health of scalp, reduces hair shedding and strengthens hair fibers.

How is Dutexome Therapy performed?
Dutexome solution is administered through microneedling. Microneedling is a non injectable technique to deliver dutexome solution into the skin to a depth of 0.5mm. In one session, about 2ml solution is administered.

How many sessions are required?
Typically 7 shock sessions over a period of 6 months are required followed by maintenance.

Dutexome Results
Dutexome is reported to provide superior results compared to conventional PRP or GFC therapies. Dutexome treatment aims to improve hair quality, density and scalp health.
Cost of Dutexome Therapy in Mumbai
In Mumbai, the cost of Dutexome therapy ranges between Rs 20,000 to 40,000 per session.

PRF (Platelet Rich Fibrin)

Experience latest in regenerative skincare & under-eye treatment with PRF treatment. It naturally rejuvenates the skin, reduces fine lines, improves texture & targets dark circles under the eye by utilizing the power of body’s own stem cells. PRF (Platelet-Rich Fibrin) treatment is a 100% natural regenerative therapy & uses your own blood to stimulate healing, collagen production & tissue regeneration. It is an advanced form of platelet therapy & is superior to conventional PRP in many indications. In PRF treatment, platelets are slowly released slowly over 7 to 14 days. This causes maximum rejuvenation of skin than PRP.

Benefits of PRF Treatment
* Promotes natural rejuvenation of skin & hair
* Stimulates collagen & elastin formation
* Reduces fine lines & wrinkles
* Brightens skin tone & improves texture
* Minimizes under-eye bags, dark circles & hollowing
* Boosts hydration & skin health

How is PRF treatment performed?
1. Injected either intradermally or subdermally.
2. Applied on skin after doing microneedling.
3. It can be mixed with fat grafts
4. Used as fibrin Matrix.

Uses of PRF Treatment
Hair

* Post-hair transplant graft survival
* Telogen effluvium
* Improves hair thickness & density

Skin & Face
